thesis: Cognitive-theater competence is decomposed so lexical grounding, symbolic transformation, temporal inhabitation, participant/KFS binding, and returned consequence cannot substitute for one another.

factors.question: Can a surface be reconstructed into relation-bearing symbolic coordinates without treating wording as the semantic object?
Does changing order/history while preserving the event inventory change the represented consequence when it should?
Can the learner preserve who locally knows/does/receives what rather than flattening all participants into one global field?
Can inherited structure be inhabited now while remaining reopenable by non-preauthored future consequence?

staged_burdens.burden: Teach reusable face-specific lexical/formal atoms on microepisodes independent of the four target relations.
Use learned grounding to reconstruct a teacher-derived relation/theater template on withheld relation×face cells.
staged_burdens.pass_means: grounded relation/template reconstruction; not surface-referent binding

staged_burdens.burden: Hold lexical inventory approximately fixed while permuting participant-to-role and local-KFS assignments.
Hold participants and event inventory fixed while permuting temporal order/history and require consequence-sensitive change.
Compose G0-G3 across English/Japanese/Brazilian-Portuguese/Mathematics with relation×face holdouts, residual retention, and lawful WITHHOLD.
staged_burdens.pass_means: bounded cognitive-theater factorization at tested scope

staged_burdens.burden: Compile earned consequence-bearing state into learner-owned data and make capability-specific teacher/parser/trainer inaccessible.
staged_burdens.pass_means: bounded Internalizer ownership if fresh returned evaluation still passes

claim_fence: This factorization is an experimental cognitive architecture, not evidence that languages or cultures determine cognition or that populations possess fixed cognitive traits.
